metaDescription: Fruit Ninja APK download for Android: get the official Fruit Ninja 3.98.4 from Google Play, with game modes, blades, high-score tips and safe install steps.

faq.q: How do I install Fruit Ninja on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Fruit Ninja and check the developer is Halfbrick Studios before tapping Install. It needs Android 6.0 or newer. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Halfbrick Studios and may be altered, so the safest way to play Fruit Ninja is the official listing.

faq.q: What are the Fruit Ninja game modes?
faq.a: Classic (three misses and you're out), Arcade (a 60-second score attack with bonus bananas) and Zen (90 seconds, no bombs). Events and battle modes rotate too.
Yes. It's free on Google Play with ads and optional purchases for blades, dojos and starfruit.

faq.q: How do I get a high score in Fruit Ninja?
faq.a: Slice three or more fruit in one swipe for combos, save fruit for big combos instead of slicing one at a time, and in Arcade, prioritise the Frenzy and Double Score bananas.
